title: Day 3/28 - Create an Azure Storage Account Using Terraform (it's easy)
description:
Master Azure Storage with Terraform: Complete Step-by-Step Tutorial for Beginners (Day 3/28)
Welcome to Day 3 of our comprehensive 28-Day Terraform with Azure journey! 

Today, we're diving into one of the most fundamental Azure resources: Storage Accounts. This hands-on tutorial will guide you through creating and configuring Azure Storage Accounts using Infrastructure as Code principles with Terraform.

In this detailed walkthrough, you'll learn:
✅ How to set up proper authentication and authorization to Azure using Service Principals
✅ The step-by-step process for creating and managing Azure Resource Groups with Terraform
✅ Complete configuration syntax for provisioning Azure Storage Accounts
✅ Understanding resource dependencies and how Terraform handles them automatically
✅ Best practices for organizing your Terraform code for Azure resources

This tutorial is perfect for cloud engineers, DevOps professionals, and anyone looking to automate their Azure infrastructure deployment. We'll break down each concept into easy-to-understand examples, showing you both the code and the reasoning behind each configuration choice.
By the end of this video, you'll have successfully deployed a fully functional Azure Storage Account using Terraform and gained the foundational knowledge needed to provision more complex Azure services in future tutorials.

This is part of our comprehensive "Terraform with Azure: Zero to Hero in 28 Days" course. 

Subscribe to follow along with a new lesson every day!
